the highest tertile of serum α1-antychymotrypsins is associated with an increased odds ratio of cognitive decline on the MMSTE.

the highest tertile of the serum inflammatory protein ACT was associated with cognitive decline, but CRP, IL6, and album in were not associated with cognition.

the association between inflammation and cognitive decline in old age.
